collection.description: Contractions begin during a rainy night.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Contractions begin during a rainy night. The father, (name1), grips the bedframe while the healer prepares supplies; he wants to be addressed as himself, even when everyone is hurried.

choices.label: Ask for a Familiar Support Person
Tell the Healer What He Needs

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Their steady presence helps him through the difficult hours.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They arrive late, but he manages with the healer until then.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The healer respects his requests while monitoring the birth.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The healer misunderstands at first and corrects course promptly.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: He finds a rhythm and eventually welcomes his newborn.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Labor lasts longer than expected, and the healer stays close.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The room settles, and he can concentrate.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: A sudden complication requires more helpers; they explain what is happening.
